jobs.title: Operations Lead ( Transfer Agency)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll build and lead our India Operations team from zero — defining roles, hiring, and designing coverage across Indian and U.S. hours. This is a player-coach role: hands-on execution early, scaling through hiring and delegation as the team grows. You'll own the day-to-day running of a U.S. stock transfer agency and act as the first line of defense on a live share register.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Recruit, train, and manage the India Operations team; define roles, onboarding, and coverage across IST/U.S. Eastern hours

 - Own service quality end-to-end: SLAs, maker-checker controls, error tracking, escalation

 - Own the SOP library; close documentation gaps and drive automation with U.S. operations, compliance, and engineering

 - Run daily DTC operations: pending-transfer reviews, DWAC/DRS processing, FAST/SCL balancing

 - Process issuances and treasury orders under maker-checker controls

 - Review and process transfers — routine, estate, broker, certificate-to-DRS — with document and medallion verification

 - Own KYC/KYB review and OFAC/adverse-media screening; escalate matches immediately

 - Handle shareholder and issuer support: account inquiries, lost-holder cases, certificate replacements

 - Own recurring SEC compliance reporting (Rules 17Ad-2/17Ad-6/17Ad-17, DTCC CBRS, escheatment)

 - Lead proxy season, paying agency, and corporate actions execution

 - Own new-issuer onboarding: appointment packages, DTC agent-change notices, legacy record ingestion

 - Write and maintain SOPs; drive process improvement and automation with engineering


ROLE REQUIREMENTS

 - 10+ years in securities or transfer agency operations (global transfer agent, Indian RTA, asset manager, or bank securities-services center)

 - Proven experience building and leading operations teams from scratch

 - Deep respect for written procedure; judgment to escalate when a case doesn't fit it

 - Bachelor's degree in commerce, finance, accounting, or a related field

 - Strong data skills: Excel/Sheets, unfamiliar file formats; basic scripting a plus

 - Expert user of Claude or an equivalent AI assistant

 - Meticulous attention to detail and clear written English

 - Reliability against hard cutoffs; this role operates on U.S. Eastern Time (ET) hours

 - High integrity and discretion handling PII and material non-public information


NICE TO HAVES

 - Exposure to DTC/DTCC systems (FAST, DWAC, DRS Profile, Cede & Co., CBRS, omnibus proxies) and SEC 17Ad-series rules

 - Experience with record conversions/deconversions or legacy data migration

 - Familiarity with Rule 144, medallion guarantees, escheatment, KYC/KYB, AML, or proxy/annual-meeting logistics

 - Experience running U.S. or cross-border operations from India against U.S.-hours SLAs


BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation commensurate with experience

 - Equity participation

 - Comprehensive health insurance, paid leave, and wellness benefits

 - Fully remote (India)

 - A true zero-to-one leadership mandate, backed by the U.S. leadership team

 - Modern operations environment with purpose-built tooling and AI assistance

To apply: send your résumé and a short note on a team or operation you've built (what you inherited, what you changed, and how you measured it) to careers@vinylequity.com.
